verses.original: δὲ πάντες οἱ τελῶναι καὶ οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ Ἦσαν ἐγγίζοντες αὐτῷ ἀκούειν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: de pantes hoi telōnai kai hoi hamartōloi Ēsan engizontes autō akouein autou
verses.literal: Now all the tax collectors and - sinners were gathering around - to listen to [Jesus]

verses.original: καὶ τε οἵ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς διεγόγγυζον λέγοντες ὅτι Οὗτος προσδέχεται ἁμαρτωλοὺς καὶ συνεσθίει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai te hoi Pharisaioi kai hoi grammateis diegongyzon legontes hoti Houtos prosdechetai hamartōlous kai synesthiei autois
verses.literal: So - the Pharisees and - scribes began to grumble - - This [man] welcomes sinners and eats with them

verses.original: δὲ Εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ταύτην τὴν παραβολὴν λέγων
verses.transliteration: de Eipen pros autous tautēn tēn parabolēn legōn
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] told . . . them this - parable -

verses.original: Τίς ἄνθρωπος ἐξ ὑμῶν ἔχων ἑκατὸν πρόβατα καὶ ἀπολέσας ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐ καταλείπει τὰ ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ πορεύεται ἐπὶ τὸ ἀπολωλὸς ἕως εὕρῃ αὐτό
verses.transliteration: Tis anthrōpos ex hymōn echōn hekaton probata kai apolesas hen ex autōn ou kataleipei ta enenēkonta ennea en tē erēmō kai poreuetai epi to apolōlos heōs heurē auto
verses.literal: What man among you [if] he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them {does} not leave the ninety-nine . . . in the pasture and go after the [one] that is lost until he finds it

verses.original: καὶ εὑρὼν ἐπιτίθησιν χαίρων ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὤμους
verses.transliteration: kai heurōn epitithēsin chairōn epi autou tous ōmous
verses.literal: And when he finds [it] he joyfully puts [it] . . . on his - shoulders

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν εἰς τὸν οἶκον συνκαλεῖ τοὺς φίλους καὶ τοὺς γείτονας λέγων αὐτοῖς Συνχάρητέ μοι ὅτι εὗρον μου τὸ ἀπολωλός τὸ πρόβατόν
verses.transliteration: kai elthōn eis ton oikon synkalei tous philous kai tous geitonas legōn autois Syncharēte moi hoti heuron mou to apolōlos to probaton
verses.literal: - comes vvv vvv home [and] calls together [his] friends and - neighbors to tell them Rejoice with me for I have found my - lost - sheep

verses.original: λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὕτως ἔσται χαρὰ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἐπὶ ἑνὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ μετανοοῦντι ἢ ἐπὶ ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα δικαίοις οἵτινες ἔχουσιν οὐ χρείαν μετανοίας
verses.transliteration: legō hymin hoti houtōs estai chara en tō ouranō epi heni hamartōlō metanoounti ē epi enenēkonta ennea dikaiois hoitines echousin ou chreian metanoias
verses.literal: I tell you that in the same way there will be [more] joy in - heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine . . . righteous ones who do not need to repent

verses.original: Ἢ τίς γυνὴ ἔχουσα δέκα δραχμὰς ἐὰν ἀπολέσῃ μίαν δραχμὴν οὐχὶ ἅπτει λύχνον καὶ σαροῖ τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ ζητεῖ ἐπιμελῶς ἕως εὕρῃ οὗ
verses.transliteration: Ē tis gynē echousa deka drachmas ean apolesē mian drachmēn ouchi haptei lychnon kai saroi tēn oikian kai zētei epimelōs heōs heurē hou
verses.literal: Or what woman who has ten silver coins [and] loses one [of them] {does} not light a lamp - sweep [her] house and search carefully until she finds it

verses.original: καὶ εὑροῦσα συνκαλεῖ τὰς φίλας καὶ γείτονας λέγουσα Συνχάρητέ μοι ὅτι εὗρον τὴν ἣν ἀπώλεσα δραχμὴν
verses.transliteration: kai heurousa synkalei tas philas kai geitonas legousa Syncharēte moi hoti heuron tēn hēn apōlesa drachmēn
verses.literal: And when she finds [it] she calls together [her] friends and neighbors to say Rejoice with me for I have found [my] - lost coin

verses.original: οὕτως λέγω ὑμῖν γίνεται χαρὰ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ τῶν ἀγγέλων ἐπὶ ἑνὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ μετανοοῦντι
verses.transliteration: houtōs legō hymin ginetai chara enōpion tou Theou tōn angelōn epi heni hamartōlō metanoounti
verses.literal: In the same way I tell you there is joy in the presence - of God’s - angels over one sinner who repents

verses.original: δέ Εἶπεν τις Ἄνθρωπός εἶχεν δύο υἱούς
verses.transliteration: de Eipen tis Anthrōpos eichen dyo huious
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] said [There was] a man who had two sons

verses.original: καὶ ὁ νεώτερος αὐτῶν εἶπεν τῷ πατρί Πάτερ δός μοι τὸ ἐπιβάλλον μέρος τῆς οὐσίας δὲ ὁ διεῖλεν τὸν βίον αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai ho neōteros autōn eipen tō patri Pater dos moi to epiballon meros tēs ousias de ho dieilen ton bion autois
verses.literal: - The younger [son] said to [him] Father give me - my share of the estate So - he divided [his] property between them

verses.original: Καὶ μετ’ οὐ πολλὰς ἡμέρας ὁ νεώτερος υἱὸς συναγαγὼν πάντα ἀπεδήμησεν εἰς μακράν χώραν καὶ ἐκεῖ διεσκόρπισεν αὐτοῦ τὴν οὐσίαν ἀσώτως ζῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai met’ ou pollas hēmeras ho neōteros huios synagagōn panta apedēmēsen eis makran chōran kai ekei dieskorpisen autou tēn ousian asōtōs zōn
verses.literal: - After vvv a few days the younger son got everything together . . . [and] journeyed to a distant country - [where] he squandered his - wealth in wild living

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ Δαπανήσαντος πάντα ἰσχυρὰ λιμὸς ἐγένετο κατὰ ἐκείνην τὴν χώραν καὶ αὐτὸς ἤρξατο ὑστερεῖσθαι
verses.transliteration: de autou Dapanēsantos panta ischyra limos egeneto kata ekeinēn tēn chōran kai autos ērxato hystereisthai
verses.literal: After he had spent all [he had] a severe famine swept through that - country and he began to be in need

verses.original: καὶ πορευθεὶς ἐκολλήθη ἑνὶ τῶν πολιτῶν ἐκείνης τῆς χώρας καὶ ἔπεμψεν αὐτὸν εἰς αὐτοῦ τοὺς ἀγροὺς βόσκειν χοίρους
verses.transliteration: kai poreutheis ekollēthē heni tōn politōn ekeinēs tēs chōras kai epempsen auton eis autou tous agrous boskein choirous
verses.literal: [So] he went [and] hired himself out to a - citizen of that - country [who] sent him into his - fields to feed [the] pigs

verses.original: καὶ ἐπεθύμει γεμίσαι αὐτοῦ τὴν κοιλίαν ἐκ τῶν κερατίων ὧν οἱ χοῖροι ἤσθιον καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδίδου αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai epethymei gemisai autou tēn koilian ek tōn keratiōn hōn hoi choiroi ēsthion kai oudeis edidou autō
verses.literal: - He longed to fill his - belly with the pods - the pigs were eating but no one would give him [ a thing ]

verses.original: δὲ ἐλθὼν Εἰς ἑαυτὸν ἔφη Πόσοι τοῦ μου πατρός μίσθιοι περισσεύονται ἄρτων δὲ ὧδε ἐγὼ λιμῷ ἀπόλλυμαι
verses.transliteration: de elthōn Eis heauton ephē Posoi tou mou patros misthioi perisseuontai artōn de hōde egō limō apollymai
verses.literal: Finally he came to his senses [and] said How many of my father’s hired servants have plenty of food but here I {am} starving to death

verses.original: ἀναστὰς πορεύσομαι πρὸς μου τὸν πατέρα καὶ ἐρῶ αὐτῷ Πάτερ ἥμαρτον εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἐνώπιόν σου
verses.transliteration: anastas poreusomai pros mou ton patera kai erō autō Pater hēmarton eis ton ouranon kai enōpion sou
verses.literal: I will get up [and] go back to my - father and say to him Father I have sinned against - heaven and against you

verses.original: εἰμὶ οὐκέτι ἄξιος κληθῆναι σου υἱός ποίησόν με ὡς ἕνα τῶν σου μισθίων
verses.transliteration: eimi ouketi axios klēthēnai sou huios poiēson me hōs hena tōn sou misthiōn
verses.literal: I am no longer worthy to be called your son Make me like one of your hired servants

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναστὰς ἦλθεν πρὸς ἑαυτοῦ τὸν πατέρα δὲ αὐτοῦ ἔτι μακρὰν ἀπέχοντος αὐτοῦ ὁ πατὴρ εἶδεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐσπλαγχνίσθη καὶ δραμὼν ἐπέπεσεν ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν τράχηλον καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai anastas ēlthen pros heautou ton patera de autou eti makran apechontos autou ho patēr eiden auton kai esplanchnisthē kai dramōn epepesen epi autou ton trachēlon kai katephilēsen auton
verses.literal: So he got up [and] went to his - father But while he {was} still vvv in the distance his - father saw him and was filled with compassion - He ran [to his son] embraced him . . . . . . . . . . . . and kissed him

verses.original: δὲ ὁ υἱὸς Εἶπεν αὐτῷ Πάτερ ἥμαρτον εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἐνώπιόν σου εἰμὶ οὐκέτι ἄξιος κληθῆναι σου υἱός
verses.transliteration: de ho huios Eipen autō Pater hēmarton eis ton ouranon kai enōpion sou eimi ouketi axios klēthēnai sou huios
verses.literal: - The son declared - Father I have sinned against - heaven and against you I am no longer worthy to be called your son

verses.original: δὲ ὁ πατὴρ Εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοῦ τοὺς δούλους Ταχὺ ἐξενέγκατε τὴν πρώτην στολὴν καὶ ἐνδύσατε αὐτόν καὶ δότε δακτύλιον εἰς αὐτοῦ τὴν χεῖρα καὶ ὑποδήματα εἰς τοὺς πόδας
verses.transliteration: de ho patēr Eipen pros autou tous doulous Tachy exenenkate tēn prōtēn stolēn kai endysate auton kai dote daktylion eis autou tēn cheira kai hypodēmata eis tous podas
verses.literal: But the father said to his - servants Quick Bring the best robe and put it on him - Put a ring on his - finger and sandals on his feet

verses.original: καὶ φέρετε τὸν τὸν σιτευτόν μόσχον θύσατε καὶ φαγόντες εὐφρανθῶμεν
verses.transliteration: kai pherete ton ton siteuton moschon thysate kai phagontes euphranthōmen
verses.literal: - Bring the - fattened calf [and] kill [it] - Let us feast [and] celebrate

verses.original: ὅτι οὗτος ὁ υἱός μου ἦν νεκρὸς καὶ ἀνέζησεν ἦν ἀπολωλὼς καὶ εὑρέθη καὶ ἤρξαντο εὐφραίνεσθαι
verses.transliteration: hoti houtos ho huios mou ēn nekros kai anezēsen ēn apolōlōs kai heurethē kai ērxanto euphrainesthai
verses.literal: For this - son of mine was dead and is alive again He was lost and is found So they began to celebrate

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ ὁ πρεσβύτερος ὁ υἱὸς Ἦν ἐν ἀγρῷ καὶ ὡς ἐρχόμενος ἤγγισεν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἤκουσεν συμφωνίας καὶ χορῶν
verses.transliteration: de autou ho presbyteros ho huios Ēn en agrō kai hōs erchomenos ēngisen tē oikia ēkousen symphōnias kai chorōn
verses.literal: Meanwhile - the older - son was in [the] field and as he approached . . . the house he heard music and dancing

verses.original: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος ἕνα τῶν παίδων ἐπυνθάνετο τί ἂν ταῦτα εἴη
verses.transliteration: kai proskalesamenos hena tōn paidōn epynthaneto ti an tauta eiē
verses.literal: So he called one of the servants [and] asked what . . . was going on . . .

verses.original: σου Ὁ ἀδελφός ἥκει δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὅτι καὶ σου ὁ πατήρ ἔθυσεν τὸν τὸν σιτευτόν μόσχον ὅτι ἀπέλαβεν αὐτὸν ὑγιαίνοντα
verses.transliteration: sou Ho adelphos hēkei de Ho eipen autō hoti kai sou ho patēr ethysen ton ton siteuton moschon hoti apelaben auton hygiainonta
verses.literal: Your - brother has returned - - he said - - and your - father has killed the - fattened calf because he has him back . . . safe and sound

verses.original: δὲ Ὠργίσθη καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν εἰσελθεῖν δὲ αὐτοῦ ὁ πατὴρ ἐξελθὼν παρεκάλει αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de Ōrgisthē kai ouk ēthelen eiselthein de autou ho patēr exelthōn parekalei auton
verses.literal: - [The older son] became angry and vvv refused to go in So his - father came out [and] pleaded with him

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν τῷ αὐτοῦ πατρὶ Ἰδοὺ τοσαῦτα ἔτη δουλεύω σοι καὶ οὐδέποτε παρῆλθον ἐντολήν σου καὶ οὐδέποτε ἔδωκας ἐμοὶ ἔριφον ἵνα εὐφρανθῶ μετὰ μου τῶν φίλων
verses.transliteration: de Ho apokritheis eipen tō autou patri Idou tosauta etē douleuō soi kai oudepote parēlthon entolēn sou kai oudepote edōkas emoi eriphon hina euphranthō meta mou tōn philōn
verses.literal: But - he answered . . . . . . his father Look all these years I have served you and never disobeyed a commandment of yours Yet vvv you never gave me [even] a young goat so I could celebrate with my - friends

verses.original: δὲ ὅτε οὗτος ὁ υἱός σου ἦλθεν ὁ καταφαγών σου τὸν βίον μετὰ πορνῶν ἔθυσας τὸν σιτευτὸν μόσχον αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de hote houtos ho huios sou ēlthen ho kataphagōn sou ton bion meta pornōn ethysas ton siteuton moschon autō
verses.literal: But when this - son of yours returns from - squandering your - wealth with prostitutes you kill the fattened calf for him

verses.original: Τέκνον σὺ εἶ πάντοτε μετ’ ἐμοῦ δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτῷ καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐμὰ ἐστιν σά
verses.transliteration: Teknon sy ei pantote met’ emou de Ho eipen autō kai panta ta ema estin sa
verses.literal: Son you are always with me - - [the father] said - and all that [is] mine is yours

verses.original: δὲ ἔδει εὐφρανθῆναι καὶ χαρῆναι ὅτι οὗτος ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἦν νεκρὸς καὶ ἔζησεν καὶ ἀπολωλὼς καὶ εὑρέθη
verses.transliteration: de edei euphranthēnai kai charēnai hoti houtos ho adelphos sou ēn nekros kai ezēsen kai apolōlōs kai heurethē
verses.literal: But it was fitting to celebrate and be glad because this - brother of yours was dead and is alive again - he was lost and is found
